items.claim: Islam Makhachev is the best in the world at keeping opponents grounded once he achieves a takedown.
items.quote: Makhachev is the best in the world at keeping you there when he gets you there.

items.claim: Ian Garry's jiu-jitsu is slightly better than Jack Della Maddalena's.
items.quote: Ian Garry's uh Machado, isn't he? Mhm. So, I'mma say his jiu-jitsu is slightly better.

items.claim: Ian Garry has better jiu-jitsu than anyone Islam Makhachev has faced besides Charles Oliveira.
items.quote: I think his jiu-jitsu is much better than anyone Islam has faced besides Oliveira.

items.claim: Ian Garry will be bigger than Islam Makhachev in their fight.
items.quote: He's going to be bigger than Islam.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is better at grappling and controlling opponents on the fence than in the open mat.
items.quote: Makhachev's better keeping him down on the fence than anywhere else.
